items: Delivery windows missed; WISMO calls climbing.
Routing at daily scale exceeded solver time budgets.
Parcel telemetry sparse; failed deliveries unexplained.

blocks.x: The promise engine produces confidence-banded ETAs per stop; a Quanta-inspired routing benchmark beat the incumbent engine by 4% daily distance (industrialized with warm starts); exception agents remediate address and availability issues through customer channels; parcel telemetry explains the rest.
The engagement was structured for transfer: named pod, documented runbooks, operator enablement, and a Compound phase that keeps challenger programs and conformance monitoring running after handover.
